create_TemplateManager: create a TemplateManager instance that loads default prompt templates from the built-in defaults directory
get_template_by_name: get a named prompt template string from the TemplateManager by its key name
get_fragment_with_kwargs: get a formatted prompt fragment from the TemplateManager by passing keyword arguments
add_custom_template: add or update a custom prompt template in the TemplateManager at runtime
add_custom_fragment: add or update a custom prompt fragment in the TemplateManager at runtime
